notes.title: Major Update - Definitive Edition
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We're really glad to introduce a major update for Lornsword Winter Chronicle!
Here is the list of changes made to the game in order to improve the experience:

1 - Graphics improvements

- Introduced dynamic lights
- Added ambient occlusion
- Increased available resolutions
- Better anti-aliasing
- Improved visual FXs

2 - Core gameplay improvements

- Added Minimap! 
It greatly helps readability of the action and balances the easy and medium modes

- Added mine & farms flag control 
- The player now has to hold to demolish 
- Improved main character visibility 
- Upgrades don't heal anymore

3 - AI improvements

- Reactivity is boosted 
- AI personality traits were reinforced 
- Deeper situation analysis from the AIs 
- Better AIs reactions: tower rush, defend position...

4 - Tutorial & game onboarding improved

- Introduced "Learn by objectives" option 
- Texts skimming 
- Color helps 
- Improved Timings 
- Better balancing 

5 - Visual improvements

- Redrawn in-game portraits 
- Better cinematics visuals: drawings, lightings flickering
- Improved text readability

6 - Additional localizations

Lornsword Winter Chronicle is now available for the following languages:

- French
- German
- Russian
- Simplified Chinese
- Spanish

And many other improvements to make the game experience as smooth as possible.

Thank you for the continued support on Lornsword!

notes.notes:

Dear defenders of the Empire !

Our second Early Access update is now live on steam!

For this update we’ve improved Corun and Eshee skills and the battle dynamics while re-balancing the economy.

Here’s the main list of changes:

Improved swordplay:	 	 			                                                                                            

 Combo: 3rd attack deals additional damage
 New charged attack added
 Targets can now be staggered when being hit							 Impact and death visuals are clearer						                              Corun and Eshee now damage enemies when using Void Walk through them
	

Global pacing change: 

 Troops are now bigger on screen and come in proper hands of 5 	 			                                                          Hands under orange flag now synchronize their attacks 					               Troop tiers and roles now have a greater influence on the fights 				                                    Troops are now more reactive to your actions						                             The economy dynamic has been sharpened 						                          Mine usage has more importance


Quality of life improvements:

 Troops following you can be all released in one tap using the top right trigger
 Far Sight is now faster to use 				                                                                             Prologue maps now give you a skip option to play the mission without the hand holding dialogues

notes.title: Lornsword's First Early Access update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34870209/a227a5f49702688de9fd85a2f979ec74d9b167ba.png

Our very first Early Access update is now live on steam!

We’ve made quality of life improvements, visual upgrades and better keyboard bindings!

Here’s the main list of changes:


 Campaign chapter selection added (you liked the Nil Roga battle? You can now play it again!)
 New music tracks added
 Difficulty balancing improved (easy, normal and hard levels have been adjusted)
 Alert icons made clearer (you shouldn’t miss them any more)
 Shadows buildings visual improvements
 Shadows units visual improvements (if you think a unit is new, it’s not, it’s just better looking!)
 Artifact Shines are now unique (they glow in the dark!)
 Music system improvement
 Keyboard binding improvement (a highly demanded change)
 Summoning is now a direct action (previously you had to hold the button to make it work)
 Outpost visibility improved (grass, could potentially hide it before, not any more!)
 Shadows headquarters now self destruct (in chapter 2 only - careful with your units, they can be caught in that explosion!)


Do let us know what you think of this patch on our Social Media channels:
